select COUNT(*) as transactions,
            COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(amount * 100)), 0) as transaction_amount_centavos,
            SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('completed','valid','verified','validated','success') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as successful_transactions,
            SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('failed','rejected','invalid','cancelled','voided') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failed_transactions,
            MAX(created_at) as last_transaction_at from `merchant_transactions` where `merchant_id` in (select `m`.`id` from `merchants` as `m`) limit 1

select COUNT(*) as transactions,
            COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(amount * 100)), 0) as transaction_amount_centavos,
            SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('completed','valid','verified','validated','success') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as successful_transactions,
            SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('failed','rejected','invalid','cancelled','voided') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failed_transactions,
            MAX(created_at) as last_transaction_at, `merchant_id` from `merchant_transactions` where `merchant_id` in (?, ?) group by `merchant_id`

select `m`.*, COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN ei.environment<>'production' THEN 'certification' WHEN ei.status IN ('error','failed','rejected') THEN 'error' ELSE 'pending' END FROM eis_integrations ei WHERE ei.merchant_id=m.id ORDER BY ei.updated_at DESC,ei.id DESC LIMIT 1),'not_connected') as registry_eis_status from `merchants` as `m` order by `m`.`created_at` desc, `m`.`id` asc limit 10 offset 0

select COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind='fee' THEN -amount_centavos ELSE 0 END),0) as charged_centavos,
            SUM(CASE WHEN kind='fee' AND amount_centavos<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as charged_transactions,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind='topup' AND amount_centavos>0 THEN amount_centavos ELSE 0 END),0) as deposits_centavos,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind='withdrawal' THEN -amount_centavos ELSE 0 END),0) as withdrawals_centavos, `merchant_id` from `merchant_wallet_entries` where `merchant_id` in (?, ?) group by `merchant_id`

select `registry_stage`, COUNT(*) as total from (select COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(m.registry_details) THEN m.registry_details ELSE '{}' END, '$.stage')), 'null'), CASE WHEN m.status='active' THEN 'onboarded' ELSE 'evaluation' END) as registry_stage from `merchants` as `m`) as `registry_stages` group by `registry_stage`

select `merchant_id`, SUM(CASE WHEN environment='live' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as live_keys,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN environment='sandbox' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as sandbox_keys from `merchant_api_keys` where `merchant_id` in (?, ?) and `status` = ? and `expires_at` > ? group by `merchant_id`
select `merchant_id`, COUNT(*) as sandbox_events, MAX(created_at) as last_sandbox_at from `integration_sandbox_events` where `merchant_id` in (?, ?) and `environment` = ? group by `merchant_id`
